label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss) is TP. User input from request.getParameterValues flows through doSomething (which performs a trivial trailing-character replacement that does not sanitize HTML) into the variable bar. bar is included in an Object array obj, which is passed to response.getWriter().printf. The data is written directly to the response body without HTML encoding, and X-XSS-Protection is disabled. Resolved sink value is attacker-controlled.

evidence.note: doSomething performs trivial replacement, not encoding
Sink: obj passed to printf writing to response body without encoding
